entries.revision_note: Live wiki/query service; no immutable revision. Record query text, retrieval timestamp and (ideally) the dump date or result hashes at ingestion.
entries.license_quote: All that data is licensed CC0, "No rights reserved", for the public domain.
entries.content_provenance: Human-curated (plus bot-imported) structured statements; facts such as capitals/element symbols.
entries.intended_use: Source facts for templated SFT factual QA (e.g., country capitals, element symbols) and a disjoint held-out factual eval set.
entries.redistribution: Unrestricted (CC0). Data_access page applies CC0 to dumps, Linked Data, query service and API.
entries.attribution_text: Not required. Courtesy credit requested: 'Facts derived from Wikidata (https://www.wikidata.org), CC0 1.0.'
restrictions: CC0 covers main/Property/Lexeme/EntitySchema namespaces only; text in other namespaces is CC BY-SA 4.0 - do not ingest talk/project pages.
Do not pull Wikipedia article text via sitelinks (CC BY-SA).
WDQS limits: 60 s query timeout, 60 s processing per 60 s per client, 5 parallel queries per IP, 30 error queries/min; honor HTTP 429 + Retry-After or risk ban.
Wikimedia User-Agent policy: informative UA with contact info, else 403/blocking (e.g. 'Juniper1-FactBuilder/1.0 (contact: <owner email or URL>)').
Use of the site subject to Wikimedia Terms of Use; Data_access asks for gzip and modest request volume.
Facts can be wrong/vandalized; cross-check values and pin retrieval date. Split train vs held-out eval by entity.
entries.decision_scope: Disjoint entity subsets: SFT and held-out eval
entries.rationale: Wikidata states its structured data, including via the query service, is CC0 with no attribution requirement, so commercial training use is clear.
